text:
miri: Hey all — onboarding hiccup: new customer ran the Node quickstart and hit a 402 on the very first API call. UI in the console says 'Set payment method' which confused them because quickstart mentions a free trial.

alex: Can you paste the curl or SDK snippet and workspace id? 402 means billing gating.

miri: workspace rdw-acme-test. curl used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"hello"}'
Response: { "error": { "code": 402, "message": "Workspace payment method required: workspace rdw-acme-test" } }

sam: We removed the one-call grace for prod-tier models last quarter to deter abuse. Quickstart should recommend the preview model for trial runs.

miri: Which preview model name should we put in the docs so users can get an immediate success?

sam: Use redwood-mini-preview for onboarding tests. It's not gated and gives free tokens for small demos. Example Node snippet to override model included in PR.

jess: From a product POV we also need clearer console messaging. 'Set payment method' should mention "production models require payment method; use preview model for trial" as a tooltip. Filing a ticket.

alex: Devex action items: 1) update quickstart to include preview fallback, 2) add a troubleshooting note for 402, 3) add example SDK snippet showing model override.

miri: I pushed a tiny docs patch with the fallback example and troubleshooting blurb. Testing now...

miri: switched to redwood-mini-preview and got 200: {"id":"resp_01","output":[{"content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"hello!"}]}]}

devex-bot: Runbook link added to onboarding guide: https://go/release/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Thanks — let's also add an internal note about the policy change so CS can explain to customers. :thumbsup:

jess: Filing follow-up for console tooltip and product-flag to allow a single sample call for verified org domains. cc @alex-pm

miri: Closing this thread; quickstart PR link in comments.
